info.name: EODHD Financial Data Calendar Corporate Actions API

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of entries per result, from 1 to 1000. Default is 100.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for transactions (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to one year before current date.

params.name: to
params.description: End date for transactions (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to current date.

params.name: code
params.description: Ticker symbol for filtering results (e.g., 'AAPL.US'). If omitted, returns data for all symbols.

items.docs: Fetch insider transaction data for US-listed companies. Covers insider buys and sells, providing transaction details such as date, shares, and price.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for symbol change history in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

params.name: to
params.description: End date for symbol change history in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Response format. Options are 'json' and 'csv'. Defaults to JSON.

items.docs: Retrieve the symbol change history within a specified date range. Only US exchanges are currently supported.
